DML.SELECT: SELECT incident_report_log_id as "id", incident_report_id as "incidentReportId", user_id as "userId", log_subtype_id as "logSubtypeId", level as "level", log_timestamp as "time", enabled as "enabled", visible as "visible" FROM rt.ims_incident_report_logs WHERE enabled = true or enabled is null
DML.INSERT: INSERT INTO rt.ims_incident_report_logs (incident_report_log_id, incident_report_id, log_subtype_id, user_id, level, log_timestamp, enabled, visible, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (:id=getNextValFromSec{'rt.last_incident_report_log_id'}, :incidentReportId, :logSubtypeId, :userId, :level, :time, :enabled, :visible, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
DML.UPDATE: UPDATE rt.ims_incident_report_logs SET incident_report_id = :incidentReportId, user_id = :userId, log_subtype_id = :logSubtypeId, level = :level, log_timestamp = :time, enabled = :enabled, visible = :visible, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE incident_report_log_id = :id
